description: Chinese historical and military fiction with institutionally precise terminology and natural English prose.

style: Natural, polished English historical and genre prose.
Preserve character voice, hierarchy, cultural context, and authorial intent.
terminology_preservation_rules: Use established glossary renderings exactly according to their status.

Preserve distinctions among historical offices, official titles, military ranks, military units, institutions, factions, geography, states, dynasties, and recurring historical or military terminology.
Do not replace Chinese institutions or titles with approximate Western equivalents merely for familiarity.
Do not admit ordinary vocabulary, generic objects, generic tactical phrases, or one-off descriptions into the glossary.
translation_policy.pinyin_preference: Personal names normally use established romanization or pinyin; meaningful titles, aliases, and epithets may be translated when context requires it.
translation_policy.semantic_translation_preference: Prefer readable semantic English for descriptive organizations, sects, locations, techniques, artifacts, and institutions when accurate and consistent; do not default automatically to pinyin.

review_priorities: Character names, aliases, and proper-name romanization.
Official titles, government offices, military ranks, and military units.
Institutions, organizations, factions, sects, states, and dynasties.
Historical geography and recurring historical or military terminology.
Formal named techniques and artifacts where future consistency matters.
Reject ordinary vocabulary, generic objects, promotional language, and one-off descriptions.

priorities: Historical offices, official titles, military ranks, and military units.
